literal_meaning: উঁচু গাছে ঝড় বেশী (Storms are more in tall trees)
figurative_meaning_bn: বড়কেই সংসারের সব ঝক্কিঝামেলা সামলাতে হয়
figurative_meaning_en: The prominent or higher-status individuals have to bear the brunt of all family or societal troubles
similar_in_english: The taller the tree, the harder the wind blows
Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে পরিবারের কাকা, তাই উঁচুগাছে ঝড় বেশী—সব ঝামেলা তারই সামলাতে হয়।
পদোন্নতির পর তার দায়িত্ব বেড়েছে, উঁচুগাছে ঝড় বেশী বলেই তো।
example_sentences_in_english: He's the family patriarch, so as the idiom goes, taller trees face more storms—all troubles fall on him.
After his promotion, his responsibilities increased; after all, the higher you go, the more the wind blows.
note: This idiom draws from natural observations in rural Bengal, emphasizing social hierarchies.
